pages.title: Take
pages.text: A hopper item denotes the "take" action, which by default means picking up loose items. Bound pillagers can even pick up fired arrows as items.$(br2)Filters in $(bold)item foci$() determine what a mob can pick up. If there are no such filters, it picks up anything.

pages.title: Block Foci Filters
pages.text: A blank $(bold)block focus$() or Web of Fate tells the mob to take items from that world position, either loose or from an inventory.$(br2)A container block (barrel, furnace, etc.) in a block focus tells the mob to take items from containers of that type.$(br2)Non-container blocks tell the mob to take items that have been dropped on top of that block type.
